nodes.label: Model
nodes.desc: Abstract hub of every NeMo model: Typing, Serialization, FileIO and HuggingFaceFileIO mixins, plus the from_pretrained registry over NGC and HF Hub.

nodes.label: ModelPT
nodes.desc: LightningModule base for classic NeMo models: config-driven init, dataset/optimizer setup, artifact registration and .nemo save/restore.

nodes.label: NeuralModule
nodes.desc: torch.nn.Module plus Typing and Serialization: the reusable, type-checked building block of every collection.

nodes.label: NeuralType
nodes.desc: Semantic dtype+axes type system that validates ports between modules at wiring time.

nodes.label: SaveRestoreConnector
nodes.desc: Pluggable connector that writes and reads .nemo archives (model YAML + weights + registered artifacts).

nodes.label: Exportable
nodes.desc: Mixin defining input/output names, export formats and the export() entry point for deployment.

nodes.label: HuggingFaceFileIO
nodes.desc: Mixin that searches Hugging Face Hub for NeMo models and pushes trained models back to the Hub.

nodes.label: ASRModel
nodes.desc: Abstract speech-recognition base: auxiliary-loss registry, WER plumbing, CUDA-graph toggles and PretrainedModelInfo listing.

nodes.label: EncDecCTCModelBPE
nodes.desc: Encoder-encoder-decoder CTC model over subword vocabularies with runtime change_vocabulary and decoding strategy.

nodes.label: EncDecRNNTBPEModel
nodes.desc: RNN-T transducer model over BPE vocabularies, the streaming-friendly family behind FastConformer and Parakeet.

nodes.label: ConformerEncoder
nodes.desc: Streaming-capable Conformer encoder built from typed neural modules; front-end of most modern NeMo ASR models.

nodes.label: SpectrogramGenerator
nodes.desc: Abstract text-to-spectrogram base; sibling abstract Vocoder and TextToWaveform bases share the same file.

nodes.label: FastPitchModel
nodes.desc: FastPitch text-to-spectrogram model mixing SpectrogramGenerator, Exportable and adapter mixins.

nodes.label: HifiGanModel
nodes.desc: HiFi-GAN vocoder converting spectrograms to waveform, marked Exportable for deployment.

nodes.label: SALM
nodes.desc: Speech-Aware Language Model: LightningModule + HFHubMixin that interleaves audio embeddings with text tokens.

nodes.label: AudioPerceptionModule
nodes.desc: NeuralModule wrapping an audio encoder for speech-language models, with export support and frame timing metadata.

nodes.label: DuplexS2SModel
nodes.desc: Duplex speech-to-speech model: full-duplex listening-and-speaking LightningModule in the HF style.

nodes.label: NeMoSpeechLMForConditionalGeneration
nodes.desc: vLLM plugin wrapper that registers SALM into the vLLM multimodal registry for serving.

nodes.label: SentencePieceTokenizer
nodes.desc: Shared SentencePiece/BPE tokenizer implementing TokenizerSpec with chat-template support.

nodes.label: get_megatron_tokenizer
nodes.desc: Downloads and builds Megatron-LM vocabulary tokenizers shared with the Megatron ecosystem.

nodes.label: CallbackGroup
nodes.desc: Singleton that fans NeMo lifecycle hooks out to every registered BaseCallback.

nodes.label: BaseCallback
nodes.desc: Base class NeMo callbacks implement so CallbackGroup can dispatch lifecycle events to them.

nodes.label: NeMoModelCheckpoint
nodes.desc: Lightning ModelCheckpoint subclass that also saves .nemo files and handles distributed-aware naming.

nodes.label: exp_manager
nodes.desc: One-call setup of loggers, checkpointing, fault tolerance and resume logic around a Lightning Trainer.

nodes.label: import_class_by_path
nodes.desc: Helpers for unpickling config class paths, upgrading config versions and locating checkpoint artifacts.

nodes.label: AppState
nodes.desc: Singleton registry of distributed ranks, model/data parallel sizes and cluster context consulted during save/restore.

nodes.label: ExportFormat + export helpers
nodes.desc: ExportFormat enum plus module-swap and ONNX-runtime verification helpers used by Exportable.
